title_en: BLISS: A Lightweight Bilevel Influence Scoring Method for Data Selection in Language Model Pretraining
title_zh: BLISS：用于语言模型预训练数据选择的轻量级双层影响力评分方法

sentences.en: Effective data selection is essential for pretraining large language models (LLMs), improving efficiency and generalization to downstream tasks.
sentences.zh: 有效的数据选择对于预训练大语言模型（LLM）至关重要，它能够提升效率并改善对下游任务的泛化。

sentences.en: However, existing approaches often rely on external pretrained models, making it difficult to separate the benefits of data selection from those introduced by external models.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有方法常常依赖外部预训练模型，这使得很难将数据选择带来的收益与外部模型引入的收益区分开来。

sentences.en: In addition, many methods estimate data importance from a fixed model state or short-horizon update, making it hard to capture how data preference changes as the model evolves during pretraining.
sentences.zh: 此外，许多方法从固定的模型状态或短视界的更新来估计数据的重要性，这使得难以捕捉随着模型在预训练过程中演化、数据偏好是如何变化的。

sentences.en: In this paper, we introduce BLISS (BileveL Influence Scoring method for data Selection), a lightweight data selection method that operates entirely \emph{from scratch}, without external pretrained oracle models, while modeling dynamic data preference.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们引入了 BLISS（BileveL Influence Scoring method for data Selection，双层数据选择影响评分方法）——一种完全从零开始（\emph{from scratch}）运作的轻量级数据选择方法，它无需外部预训练的 oracle 模型，同时能够对动态的数据偏好进行建模。

sentences.en: BLISS uses a small proxy model as a surrogate for the LLM and trains a score model to estimate sample importance through multi-step proxy updates induced by score-weighted training data.
sentences.zh: BLISS 使用一个小型代理模型作为 LLM 的替代，并训练一个评分模型，通过由评分加权训练数据所诱导的多步代理更新来估计样本的重要性。

sentences.en: We formulate data selection as a bilevel optimization problem: the upper-level objective optimizes the score model to assign sample weights, so minimizing the lower-level weighted training loss improves validation performance.
sentences.zh: 我们将数据选择表述为一个双层优化问题：上层目标优化评分模型以分配样本权重，从而通过最小化下层的加权训练损失来提升验证性能。

sentences.en: Once optimized, the score model predicts influence scores, enabling efficient selection of high-quality samples for LLM pretraining.
sentences.zh: 一旦优化完成，评分模型就能预测影响分数，从而为 LLM 预训练高效地选择高质量样本。

sentences.en: We validate BLISS by pretraining 410M/1B/2.8B Pythia and LLaMA-0.5B models on selected C4 subsets.
sentences.zh: 我们通过在精选的 C4 子集上预训练 410M/1B/2.8B 规模的 Pythia 模型和 LLaMA-0.5B 模型来验证 BLISS。

sentences.en: Under the 1B setting, BLISS achieves a $1.7\times$ speedup in reaching the same performance as the state-of-the-art method, while delivering superior performance across multiple downstream tasks.
sentences.zh: 在 1B 设定下，BLISS 在达到与最先进方法相同性能时实现了 $1.7\times$ 的加速，同时在多个下游任务上展现出更优的性能。

title_en: Block Rotation is All You Need for MXFP4 Quantization
title_zh: MXFP4 量化只需分块旋转

sentences.en: Large language models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable success, but their rapidly growing scale imposes prohibitive costs in memory, computation, and energy.
sentences.zh: 大语言模型（LLM）取得了非凡的成功，但其快速增长的规模在内存、计算与能耗方面带来了高昂的成本。

sentences.en: Post-training quantization (PTQ) is a promising solution for efficient deployment, yet achieving accurate W4A4 quantization remains an open challenge.
sentences.zh: 训练后量化（PTQ）是实现高效部署的一种有前景的解决方案，然而实现准确的 W4A4 量化仍是一个悬而未决的挑战。

sentences.en: While most existing methods are designed for INT4 formats, the emergence of MXFP4—a new FP4 format with various hardware support (NVIDIA, AMD, Intel)—raises questions about the applicability of current techniques.
sentences.zh: 尽管大多数现有方法是为 INT4 格式设计的，但一种支持多种硬件（NVIDIA、AMD、Intel）的新 FP4 格式 MXFP4 的出现，对现有技术的适用性提出了疑问。

sentences.en: In this work, we present a unified empirical comparison of representative PTQ methods under the MXFP4 format.
sentences.zh: 在这项工作中，我们对代表性 PTQ 方法在 MXFP4 格式下进行了统一的实证比较。

sentences.en: Through systematic evaluation, we find that methods like GPTQ consistently deliver strong performance, whereas rotation-based approaches, which are widely used in state-of-the-art approaches, suffer from severe incompatibility with MXFP4.
sentences.zh: 通过系统性的评估，我们发现诸如 GPTQ 之类的方法始终表现强劲，而旋转类方法（在最先进方法中广泛使用）则与 MXFP4 存在严重的不兼容问题。

sentences.en: We further provide the first in-depth analysis of this conflict, tracing its root to a fundamental mismatch between MXFP4’s PoT (power-of-two) block scaling and the redistribution of outlier energy via global rotation.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步首次对这一冲突进行了深入分析，将其根源追溯为 MXFP4 的 PoT（2 的幂）块缩放与通过全局旋转实现离群能量重新分布之间的根本性不匹配。

sentences.en: Building on this insight, we propose a simple yet effective block rotation strategy that adapts rotation-based methods to MXFP4, leading to substantial accuracy improvements across diverse LLMs.
sentences.zh: 基于这一见解，我们提出了一种简单而有效的块旋转策略，它将旋转类方法适配到 MXFP4，从而在多种 LLM 上带来显著的精度提升。

sentences.en: Our findings not only offer clear guidance for practitioners but also set a foundation for advancing PTQ research under emerging low-precision formats.
sentences.zh: 我们的发现不仅为实践者提供了清晰的指导，也为在新兴低精度格式下推进 PTQ 研究奠定了基础。

title_en: BLOCK-EM: Preventing Emergent Misalignment via Latent Blocking
title_zh: BLOCK-EM：通过潜在空间阻断防止涌现式失配

sentences.en: Emergent misalignment can arise when a language model is fine-tuned on a narrowly scoped supervised objective: the model learns the target behavior, yet also develops undesirable out-of-domain behaviors.
sentences.zh: 当语言模型在范围狭窄的监督目标上微调时，就可能会出现涌现性错位：模型学会了目标行为，但同时也发展出不受欢迎的域外行为。

sentences.en: We investigate a mechanistic approach to preventing emergent misalignment by identifying a small set of internal features that reliably control the misaligned behavior and then discouraging the model from strengthening these features during fine-tuning.
sentences.zh: 我们研究一种机制性的方法来预防涌现性错位：先识别出一小组能够可靠控制错位行为的内部特征，然后在微调期间阻止模型加强这些特征。

sentences.en: Across six fine-tuning domains, blocking (i.e., constraining) a fixed set of features achieves up to 95\% relative reduction in emergent misalignment with no degradation in model quality or target-task performance.
sentences.zh: 在六个微调领域上，阻塞（即约束）一组固定特征能够在涌现性错位上实现高达 95\% 的相对降低，同时模型质量或目标任务性能没有任何下降。

sentences.en: We strengthen validity with disjoint selection/evaluation splits, multiple independent judges, multiple random seeds for key settings, quality metrics, and extensive ablations demonstrating that the reduction in misalignment is specific to the identified mechanism.
sentences.zh: 我们通过不相交的选取/评估划分、多个独立评判者、关键设置的多个随机种子、质量指标以及大量消融实验来增强有效性，这些实验表明错位的降低是针对所识别机制的特异性效果。

sentences.en: We also characterize a limiting regime in which misalignment re-emerges under prolonged fine-tuning, present evidence consistent with rerouting through alternative features or layers, and evaluate modifications that partially restore the misalignment-blocking effect.
sentences.zh: 我们还刻画了一种极限情形：在长时间微调下错位会重新出现；我们给出了与通过替代特征或层进行重路由相一致的证据，并评估了能部分恢复错位阻塞效果的改进方案。

sentences.en: Overall, our results show that targeted training-time constraints on internal mechanisms can mitigate emergent misalignment without degrading target-task performance.
sentences.zh: 总体而言，我们的结果表明，对内部机制施加有针对性的训练期约束，能够在不对目标任务性能造成损害的情况下缓解涌现性错位。

title_en: Block-wise Codeword Embedding for Reliable Multi-bit Text Watermarking
title_zh: 通过分块码字嵌入实现可靠的多比特文本水印

sentences.en: Recent multi-bit watermarking methods for large language models (LLMs) prioritize capacity over reliability, often conflating decoding with detection.
sentences.zh: 近年来，针对大语言模型（LLM）的多比特水印方法更重视容量而非可靠性，常常将解码与检测混为一谈。

sentences.en: Our analysis reveals that existing ECC-based extractors suffer from catastrophic false positive rates (FPR), and applying rejection thresholds merely collapses detection sensitivity (TPR) to random guessing.
sentences.zh: 我们的分析表明，现有的基于 ECC 的提取器存在灾难性的假阳性率（FPR），而应用拒绝阈值只会将检测灵敏度（TPR）拉低到与随机猜测相当的水平。

sentences.en: To resolve this structural limitation, we propose **BREW** (Block-wise Reliable Embedding for Watermarking), a framework shifting the paradigm to *designated verification*.
sentences.zh: 为了解决这一结构性局限，我们提出了 **BREW**（Block-wise Reliable Embedding for Watermarking，分块可靠水印嵌入）——一个将范式转向*指定验证*的框架。

sentences.en: BREW employs a two-stage mechanism: (i) **blind message estimation** via independent block voting, followed by (ii) **window-shifting verification** that rigorously validates the payload against local edits.
sentences.zh: BREW 采用两阶段机制：(i) 通过独立分块投票进行**盲消息估计**，随后 (ii) 进行**窗口平移验证**，以严格地对局部编辑下的有效载荷进行校验。

sentences.en: Experiments demonstrate that BREW achieves a TPR of 0.965 with an FPR of 0.02 under 10\% synonym substitution, demonstrating that the high-FPR issue is not an inherent trade-off of multi-bit watermarking, but a solvable structural flaw of prior decoding-centric designs.
sentences.zh: 实验表明，在 10\% 的近义词替换下，BREW 实现了 TPR 为 0.965、FPR 为 0.02 的效果，这表明高 FPR 问题并非多比特水印固有的权衡，而是以往以解码为中心的设计中一种可解决的结构性缺陷。

sentences.en: Our framework is model-agnostic and theoretically grounded, providing a scalable solution for reliable forensic deployment.
sentences.zh: 我们的框架与模型无关且具有理论基础，为可靠的取证部署提供了一种可扩展的解决方案。

title_en: Blocking the Leakage: Manifold-Aware Gradient Projection for Long-Horizon Test-Time Adaptation
title_zh: 阻断泄漏：用于长程测试时适应的流形感知梯度投影

sentences.en: Test-Time Adaptation (TTA) empowers pre-trained models to adapt online to distribution shifts during inference, but such online updates often become unstable in long-horizon deployments.
sentences.zh: 测试时自适应（TTA）使预训练模型能够在推理过程中在线适应分布偏移，但这种在线更新的方式在长视界部署中常常变得不稳定。

sentences.en: Prevailing approaches attribute this failure to error accumulation from noisy pseudo-labels, relying on heuristics to gate samples used for updates.
sentences.zh: 主流方法将这种失败归因于来自含有噪声的伪标签的误差累积，并依靠启发式方法来筛选用于更新的样本。

sentences.en: We argue that this statistical view is insufficient: the problem lies not only in sample quality but also in the directionality of gradients.
sentences.zh: 我们认为这种统计视角并不充分：问题不仅在于样本质量，还在于梯度的方向性。

sentences.en: In this work, we identify a geometric failure mode termed manifold erosion.
sentences.zh: 在这项工作中，我们识别出一种名为流形侵蚀（manifold erosion）的几何失效模式。

sentences.en: Through spectral analysis, we find that reliable gradients concentrate in a stable low-rank subspace, while gradients from confident mispredictions are high-rank yet exhibit a persistent directional leakage into this protected subspace.
sentences.zh: 通过谱分析，我们发现可靠的梯度集中于一个稳定的低秩子空间，而来自高置信度错误预测的梯度虽然是高秩的，却会持续向这个受保护子空间发生有方向的泄漏。

sentences.en: This leakage can accumulate coherently and gradually erode core representations, eventually leading to collapse.
sentences.zh: 这种泄漏能够相干地累积，并逐渐侵蚀核心表示，最终导致塌缩。

sentences.en: To address this, we propose Manifold-Aware Gradient Projection (MGP), a geometric intervention that tracks the dominant subspace online and projects gradients onto its orthogonal complement.
sentences.zh: 为了解决这一问题，我们提出了流形感知梯度投影（MGP）——一种在线跟踪主导子空间并将其正交补空间上投影梯度的几何干预手段。

sentences.en: By blocking the leakage path, MGP decouples stability from plasticity.
sentences.zh: 通过阻断泄漏路径，MGP 将稳定性与可塑性解耦。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on diverse TTA benchmarks demonstrate its long-horizon stability, whereas prior methods often fail.
sentences.zh: 在多个不同的 TTA 基准上的大量实验证明了它的长视界稳定性，而先前的方法往往以失败告终。

title_en: BlueCodeAgent: A Blue Teaming Agent Powered by Automated Red Teaming for CodeGen AI
title_zh: BlueCodeAgent：由自动红队测试驱动的代码生成 AI 蓝队智能体

sentences.en: Existing research on CodeGen AI security mainly focuses on red teaming, which aims to uncover vulnerabilities and risks in AI-generated code.
sentences.zh: 现有关于 CodeGen AI 安全的研究主要集中在红队测试（red teaming）上，其目的是发现 AI 生成代码中的漏洞和风险。

sentences.en: However, progress on the blue teaming side remains limited, as effective defenses require a deep security analysis of given tasks and edge cases.
sentences.zh: 然而，蓝队测试（blue teaming）方面的进展仍然有限，因为有效的防御需要对给定任务和边界情况（edge cases）进行深入的安全分析。

sentences.en: To fill in this gap, we propose BlueCodeAgent, an end-to-end blue teaming agent powered by automated red teaming.
sentences.zh: 为填补这一空白，我们提出了 BlueCodeAgent，一个由自动红队测试驱动的端到端蓝队智能体。

sentences.en: Our red teaming component generates diverse risky instances, providing effective edge cases and guidance for the subsequent blue teaming process.
sentences.zh: 我们的红队测试组件会生成丰富多样的危险实例，为后续的蓝队测试过程提供有效的边界情况和指导。

sentences.en: Our blue teaming agent then conducts multi-level defense, leveraging these red teaming examples to detect previously seen and unseen risk scenarios through constitution summarization and dynamic code analysis.
sentences.zh: 随后，我们的蓝队智能体开展多层次防御，利用这些红队测试示例，通过章程总结（constitution summarization）和动态代码分析来检测已知与未知的风险场景。

sentences.en: Our evaluation across four representative code-related tasks–bias instruction detection, malicious instruction detection, vulnerable code detection, and prompt injection detection–shows that BlueCodeAgent achieves significant gains over diverse baselines.
sentences.zh: 我们在四个具有代表性的代码相关任务——偏见指令检测、恶意指令检测、漏洞代码检测和提示注入检测——上的评估表明，BlueCodeAgent 相对于多种基线取得了显著的提升。

sentences.en: In particular, for vulnerability detection tasks, BlueCodeAgent integrates dynamic analysis to effectively reduce false positives, a challenging problem as base models tend to be over-conservative.
sentences.zh: 特别是对于漏洞检测任务，BlueCodeAgent 集成了动态分析以有效减少误报，而这是一个具有挑战性的问题，因为基础模型往往过于保守。

sentences.en: Overall, with GPT-4o as the base model, BlueCodeAgent achieves an average F1 score improvement of 14.7% across four tasks compared to directly prompting the model, attributed to its ability to summarize actionable constitutions and perform dynamic analysis.
sentences.zh: 总体而言，以 GPT-4o 为基础模型时，与直接提示模型相比，BlueCodeAgent 在四个任务上的平均 F1 分数提升了 14.7%，这归功于它能够总结可执行的章程并执行动态分析。

sentences.en: Our code and data are publicly available at https://github.com/1mocat/BlueCodeAgent.
sentences.zh: 我们的代码和数据可在 https://github.com/1mocat/BlueCodeAgent 公开获取。

title_en: BM^2: Coupled Schrödinger Bridge Matching
title_zh: BM^2：耦合薛定谔桥匹配

sentences.en: A Schrödinger bridge establishes a dynamic transport map between two target distributions via a reference process, simultaneously solving an associated entropic optimal transport problem.
sentences.zh: Schrödinger 桥通过一个参考过程在两个目标分布之间建立动态传输映射，同时求解一个相关联的熵正则最优传输（entropic optimal transport）问题。

sentences.en: We consider the setting where samples from the target distributions are available, and the reference diffusion process admits tractable dynamics.
sentences.zh: 我们考虑这样一种设定：目标分布的样本可得，且参考扩散过程具有易处理的动力学。

sentences.en: We thus introduce Coupled Bridge Matching (BM$^2$), a simple \emph{non-iterative} approach for learning Schrödinger bridges with neural networks.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们提出了 Coupled Bridge Matching（BM$^2$，耦合桥匹配），这是一种利用神经网络学习 Schrödinger 桥的简单的 \emph{non-iterative}（非迭代）方法。

sentences.en: A preliminary theoretical analysis of the convergence properties of BM$^2$ is carried out, supported by numerical experiments that demonstrate the effectiveness of our proposal.
sentences.zh: 我们对 BM$^2$ 的收敛性质进行了初步的理论分析，并通过数值实验加以佐证；这些实验证明了我们所提出方法的有效性。

title_en: BOCLOAK: Optimal Transport-Guided Adversarial Attacks on Graph Neural Network-Based Bot Detection
title_zh: BOCLOAK：针对基于图神经网络的机器人账号检测的最优输运引导对抗攻击

sentences.en: The rise of bot accounts on social media poses significant risks to public discourse.
sentences.zh: 社交媒体上机器人账号（bot accounts）的兴起对公共话语构成了重大风险。

sentences.en: To address this threat, modern bot detectors increasingly rely on Graph Neural Networks (GNNs).
sentences.zh: 为应对这一威胁，现代机器人检测器越来越多地依赖图神经网络（Graph Neural Network，GNN）。

sentences.en: However, the effectiveness of these GNN-based detectors in real-world settings remains poorly understood.
sentences.zh: 然而，这些基于 GNN 的检测器在真实世界场景中的有效性仍未被充分了解。

sentences.en: In practice, attackers continuously adapt their strategies and must operate under domain-specific and temporal constraints, which can fundamentally limit the applicability of existing attack methods.
sentences.zh: 在实践中，攻击者会不断调整其策略，并且必须在特定领域和时间约束下运作，这可能从根本上限制现有攻击方法的适用性。

sentences.en: As a result, there is a critical need for robust GNN-based bot detection methods under realistic, constraint-aware attack scenarios.
sentences.zh: 因此，在现实的、考虑约束的攻击场景下，迫切需要对基于 GNN 的机器人检测方法具备稳健性。

sentences.en: We introduce BOCLOAK to systematically evaluate the robustness of GNN-based bot detection via both edge editing and node injection adversarial attacks under realistic constraints.
sentences.zh: 我们提出 BOCLOAK，通过边编辑（edge editing）和节点注入（node injection）对抗攻击，系统性地评估在现实约束下基于 GNN 的机器人检测的稳健性。

sentences.en: BOCLOAK constructs a probability measure over spatio-temporal neighbor features and learns an optimal transport (OT) geometry that separates human and bot behaviors.
sentences.zh: BOCLOAK 在时空邻居特征上构建一个概率测度，并学习能够区分人类行为与机器人行为的最优传输（optimal transport，OT）几何结构。

sentences.en: It then decodes transport plans into sparse, plausible edge edits that evade detection while obeying real-world constraints.
sentences.zh: 随后，它将传输计划解码为稀疏且合理的边编辑，在遵循现实世界约束的同时规避检测。

sentences.en: We evaluate BOCLOAK across three social bot datasets, five state-of-the-art bot detectors, three adversarial defenses, and compare it against four leading graph adversarial attack baselines.
sentences.zh: 我们在三个社交机器人数据集、五种最先进的机器人检测器和三种对抗防御方法上评估 BOCLOAK，并将其与四个领先的图对抗攻击基线进行比较。

sentences.en: BOCLOAK achieves up to 80.13% higher attack success rates while using 99.80% less GPU memory under real-world constraints.
sentences.zh: 在现实世界约束下，BOCLOAK 的攻击成功率最高提升 80.13%，同时 GPU 内存使用量减少 99.80%。

sentences.en: BOCLOAK shows that OT provides a lightweight, principled framework for bridging adversarial attacks and real-world bot detection.
sentences.zh: BOCLOAK 表明，OT 为弥合对抗攻击与现实世界机器人检测之间的鸿沟提供了一个轻量且规范的理论框架。

authors.name: Kunal Mukherjee

title_en: Boost the Identity-Preserving Embedding for Consistent Visual Generation
title_zh: 增强身份保持嵌入以实现一致视觉生成

sentences.en: Text-to-image models have advanced high-fidelity content generation, but their inability to maintain subject consistency hampers realistic applications.
sentences.zh: 文生图（text-to-image）模型推动了高保真内容生成的发展，但它们无法保持主体一致性，这阻碍了其在实际应用中的使用。

sentences.en: Existing training-based methods rely on heavy computation and large datasets; while training-free approaches demand excessive memory or complex auxiliary modules.
sentences.zh: 现有的基于训练的方法依赖繁重的计算和大型数据集；而免训练的方法则要求过多的内存或复杂的辅助模块。

sentences.en: In this paper, we first reveal a key property overlooked in prior works that the identity-relevant signals, termed Identity-Preserving Embeddings (*IPemb*), are implicitly encoded in textual embeddings of frame prompts.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们首先揭示了一个以往工作所忽视的关键性质：身份相关信息（称为保持身份一致性嵌入（Identity-Preserving Embedding，*IPemb*））会隐式地编码在帧提示（frame prompts）的文本嵌入中。

sentences.en: To address the consistent T2I generation with the *IPemb* embedding, we propose Boost Identity-Preserving Embedding (*BIPE*), a training-free yet plug-and-play framework that explicitly extracts and enhances the *IPemb*.
sentences.zh: 为解决利用 *IPemb* 嵌入进行一致性的 T2I 生成的问题，我们提出了提升保持身份一致性嵌入（Boost Identity-Preserving Embedding，*BIPE*），这是一个免训练且即插即用的框架，能够显式地提取并增强 *IPemb*。

sentences.en: Its core innovations are two complementary techniques:  First, Adaptive Singular-Value Rescaling (*adaSVR*) applies singular-value decomposition to the joint embedding matrix of all frame prompts, amplifying identity-centric components  while suppressing frame-specific noise.
sentences.zh: 其核心创新在于两种互补的技术：首先，自适应奇异值重缩放（Adaptive Singular-Value Rescaling，*adaSVR*）对所有帧提示的联合嵌入矩阵进行奇异值分解，在放大以身份为中心的成分的同时抑制帧特有的噪声。

sentences.en: Second, Union Key (*UniK*) further reinforces consistency by aligning the T2I backbone’s image-text attention across the entire generation sequence.
sentences.zh: 其次，联合键（Union Key，*UniK*）通过在整个生成序列中对齐 T2I 主干网络的图文注意力，进一步强化一致性。

sentences.en: Experiments on the *ConsiStory+* benchmark demonstrate *BIPE* outperforms existing methods in both qualitative and quantitative metrics.
sentences.zh: 在 *ConsiStory+* 基准上的实验表明，*BIPE* 在定性和定量指标上都优于现有方法。

sentences.en: To address the gap in evaluating a broader range of scenarios with diversified prompt templates, we introduce a *DiverStory* benchmark to further confirm our scalability.
sentences.zh: 为解决在具有多样化提示模板的更广泛场景下评估的空白，我们引入了一个 *DiverStory* 基准以进一步验证我们的可扩展性。

title_en: BOOSTAPR: Boosting Automated Program Repair via Execution-Grounded Reinforcement Learning with Dual Reward Models
title_zh: BOOSTAPR：通过基于执行的双奖励模型强化学习增强自动程序修复

sentences.en: Reinforcement learning for program repair is hindered by sparse execution feedback and coarse sequence-level rewards that obscure which edits actually fix bugs.
sentences.zh: 用于程序修复的强化学习受到稀疏的执行反馈和粗糙的序列级奖励的阻碍，后者掩盖了究竟是哪些编辑真正修复了缺陷。

sentences.en: We present BoostAPR, a three-stage framework: (1) supervised fine-tuning on execution-verified demonstrations with reasoning traces, (2) training dual reward models—a sequence-level assessor and a line-level credit allocator—from execution outcomes, and (3) PPO optimization where the line-level model redistributes rewards to critical edit regions.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了 BoostAPR，一个三阶段框架：（1）在带有推理轨迹的、经执行验证的演示数据上进行监督微调；（2）从执行结果中训练双奖励模型——一个序列级评估器和一个行级信用分配器；（3）进行 PPO 优化，其中行级模型将奖励重新分配给关键的编辑区域。

sentences.en: This line-level credit assignment operates at an intermediate granularity naturally suited to code changes.
sentences.zh: 这种行级信用分配在一种自然契合代码变更的中间粒度上运作。

sentences.en: Trained on SWE-Gym and evaluated on four benchmarks, BoostAPR achieves 40.7% on SWE-bench Verified (+22.9pp over the base model), 24.8% on Defects4J (Python→Java transfer), 84.5% on HumanEval-Java, and 95.0% on QuixBugs, showing competitive open-source performance with strong cross-language generalization.
sentences.zh: 在 SWE-Gym 上训练并在四个基准上评估后，BoostAPR 在 SWE-bench Verified 上达到 40.7%（比基础模型高出 22.9 个百分点），在 Defects4J（Python→Java 迁移）上达到 24.8%，在 HumanEval-Java 上达到 84.5%，在 QuixBugs 上达到 95.0%，展现出具有竞争力的开源性能以及强大的跨语言泛化能力。

title_en: Boosting CVaR Policy Optimization with Quantile Gradients
title_zh: 利用分位数梯度增强条件风险价值策略优化

sentences.en: Optimizing Conditional Value-at-risk (CVaR) using policy gradient (a.k.a CVaR-PG) faces significant challenges of sample inefficiency.
sentences.zh: 使用策略梯度优化条件风险价值（Conditional Value-at-Risk，CVaR）——即 CVaR-PG——面临着一重大挑战：样本效率低下。

sentences.en: This inefficiency stems from the fact that it focuses on tail-end performance and overlooks many sampled trajectories.
sentences.zh: 这种低效源于它只关注尾部性能而忽视了许多采样的轨迹。

sentences.en: We address this problem by augmenting CVaR with an expected quantile term.
sentences.zh: 我们通过为 CVaR 增加一个期望分位数项来解决这个问题。

sentences.en: Quantile optimization admits a dynamic programming formulation that leverages all sampled data, thus improves sample efficiency.
sentences.zh: 分位数优化具有一种可以利用全部采样数据的动态规划形式，因而能够提高样本效率。

sentences.en: This does not alter the CVaR objective since CVaR corresponds to the expectation of quantile over the tail.
sentences.zh: 这并不会改变 CVaR 的目标，因为 CVaR 对应于分位数在尾部的期望。

sentences.en: Empirical results in domains with verifiable risk-averse behavior show that our algorithm within the Markovian policy class substantially improves upon CVaR-PG and consistently outperforms other existing methods.
sentences.zh: 在具有可验证的风险规避行为领域中的实证结果表明，在马尔可夫策略类别内，我们的算法相对于 CVaR-PG 取得了实质性的改进，并且持续优于其他现有方法。

title_en: Boosting Monocular Metric Depth Estimation via Bokeh Rendering
title_zh: 通过散景渲染增强单目度量深度估计

sentences.en: Bokeh rendering and depth estimation share a fundamental optical connection, yet existing methods fail to fully exploit this reciprocity.
sentences.zh: Bokeh 渲染与深度估计之间有着根本的光学联系，然而现有方法未能充分利用这种互惠关系。

sentences.en: Conventional bokeh pipelines rely heavily on noisy depth maps that inevitably introduce visual artifacts.
sentences.zh: 传统的 Bokeh 流水线严重依赖含噪的深度图，而这不可避免地会引入视觉伪影。

sentences.en: Conversely, existing monocular depth models typically follow two flawed paradigms.
sentences.zh: 相反，现有的单目深度模型通常遵循两种有缺陷的范式。

sentences.en: Generative diffusion-based frameworks often lack consistent metric scale.
sentences.zh: 基于生成扩散的框架往往缺乏一致的度量尺度。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, feed-forward metric depth models frequently fail in textureless or distant regions where defocus blur can provide geometric information.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，前馈度量深度模型在无纹理或远距离区域常常失效，而在这些区域，离焦模糊本可以提供几何信息。

sentences.en: We propose BokehDepth, a two-stage framework that treats synthetic defocus as a supervision-free geometric signal.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了 BokehDepth，一个两阶段框架，将合成离焦视为一种无需监督的几何信号。

sentences.en: In the first stage, a physically grounded generative model produces calibrated bokeh stacks from a single sharp input without requiring prior depth input.
sentences.zh: 在第一阶段，一个基于物理的生成模型仅从单张清晰输入生成经过标定的 Bokeh 堆栈，而无需先验的深度输入。

sentences.en: Subsequently, a lightweight defocus-aware aggregation module integrates these stacks into the encoder of a depth estimation framework.
sentences.zh: 随后，一个轻量级的、感知离焦的聚合模块将这些堆栈集成到深度估计框架的编码器中。

sentences.en: This mechanism allows the model to extract consistent geometric features from the defocus dimension while keeping the decoder architecture unchanged.
sentences.zh: 这种机制使模型能够从离焦维度提取一致的几何特征，同时保持解码器架构不变。

sentences.en: Experiments demonstrate that BokehDepth achieves superior visual bokeh fidelity compared to depth-dependent rendering baselines and consistently enhances the metric accuracy of state-of-the-art monocular depth models.
sentences.zh: 实验表明，与依赖深度的渲染基线相比，BokehDepth 实现了更优的视觉 Bokeh 保真度，并持续提升最先进单目深度模型的度量精度。

title_en: Boosting World Models Learning via Latent-Space Value Alignment
title_zh: 通过潜在空间价值对齐增强世界模型学习

sentences.en: Model-based reinforcement learning aims to construct world models for efficient sampling.
sentences.zh: 基于模型的强化学习旨在构建世界模型以实现高效采样。

sentences.en: Current mainstream algorithms can be broadly categorized into two paradigms: maximum likelihood and value-aware world models.
sentences.zh: 当前的主流算法大致可以分为两种范式：最大似然世界模型和值感知世界模型。

sentences.en: The former employs structured Recurrent/Transformer State-Space Models to capture environmental dynamics but overlooks task-relevant features.
sentences.zh: 前者采用结构化的循环/Transformer 状态空间模型来捕捉环境动态，但忽视了与任务相关的特征。

sentences.en: The latter prioritizes decision-critical states but suffers from sub-optimal performance.
sentences.zh: 后者更重视决策关键的状态，但其性能欠佳。

sentences.en: While recent efforts have sought to integrate these approaches, they typically rely on auxiliary modules or heavy external priors that significantly increase computational complexity.
sentences.zh: 虽然最近的尝试试图整合这些方法，但它们通常依赖辅助模块或繁重的外部先验，这会显著增加计算复杂度。

sentences.en: In this work, we propose a Value-Aligned World Model, a minimalist framework designed to synergize these two paradigms with negligible overhead.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们提出了一个值对齐世界模型（Value-Aligned World Model），这是一个极简主义框架，旨在以可忽略的额外开销协同融合这两种范式。

sentences.en: Specifically, We introduce an intrinsic latent-space value-alignment regularization that compels the world model to prioritize task-relevant features while maintaining the structural integrity of stochastic dynamics.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，我们引入了一种内在的潜在空间价值对齐正则化，促使世界模型在保持随机动态结构完整性的同时，优先关注与任务相关的特征。

sentences.en: To ensure stable optimization, we develop an adaptive weighting mechanism that acts as a self-regulating curriculum, balancing reconstruction fidelity with decision-making utility.
sentences.zh: 为确保优化的稳定性，我们开发了一种自适应加权机制，它作为一种自我调节的课程安排，在重建保真度与决策效用之间取得平衡。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on Atari 100k and DeepMind Control benchmarks demonstrate that our algorithm consistently boosts existing methods with minimal added code and computational overhead.
sentences.zh: 在 Atari 100k 和 DeepMind Control 基准上的大量实验表明，我们的算法以最少的新增代码和计算开销持续提升现有方法。

sentences.en: Code is available at supplementary material.
sentences.zh: 代码可在补充材料中获取。

title_en: Bootstrapped Exploration with Causal Reasoning: A Training Paradigm for Adaptive Forecasting Agent
title_zh: 结合因果推理的自举探索：自适应预测智能体的训练范式

sentences.en: Time series forecasting is critical in domains such as finance, energy, and healthcare, yet real-world datasets often exhibit non-stationarity, noise, missing values, and distribution shifts, posing severe challenges for generalization.
sentences.zh: 时间序列预测在金融、能源和医疗等领域的应用至关重要，然而真实世界数据集常常表现出非平稳性、噪声、缺失值和分布偏移，对泛化能力构成严峻挑战。

sentences.en: In practice, industry solutions typically rely on customized forecasting frameworks that combine imputation, decomposition, and specialized models.
sentences.zh: 在实践中，工业界的解决方案通常依赖定制的预测框架，将插补、分解和专门模型结合使用。

sentences.en: However, such frameworks are costly to engineer and maintain.
sentences.zh: 然而，这样的框架在工程实现和维护方面成本高昂。

sentences.en: Moreover, we observe that many frameworks suffer from the impacts of distribution shifts, which degrade their respective performance.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们观察到许多框架都会受到分布偏移的影响，这会降低它们各自的性能。

sentences.en: It motivates a paradigm that transfers reliably across heterogeneous datasets while accumulating reusable strategy knowledge for large-scale, dynamic environments.
sentences.zh: 这促使我们提出一种范式：它能在异构数据集之间可靠迁移，同时为大规模、动态环境积累可复用的策略知识。

sentences.en: Although large language model-based agents have recently shown strong reasoning and tool-use capabilities, existing approaches do not consistently adapt forecasting workflows across diverse time series.
sentences.zh: 尽管基于大语言模型的智能体近来展现出强大的推理和工具使用能力，但现有方法在不同时间序列之间并不能持续地调整预测工作流程。

sentences.en: We identify two primary factors, including limited strategy-level supervision and the inherent complexity of mapping dataset-specific meta-features to effective forecasting strategies.
sentences.zh: 我们识别出两个主要因素：策略级监督有限，以及将数据集特有的元特征映射到有效预测策略存在固有复杂性。

sentences.en: To address these challenges, we propose BECRA, a novel agent training paradigm that learns forecasting intelligence through contrast-aware exploration and agent-level causal lesson extraction, without human-annotated supervision.
sentences.zh: 为解决这些挑战，我们提出了 BECRA，一种新颖的智能体训练范式，它通过对比感知的探索和智能体级因果经验提取来学习预测智能，而无需人工标注的监督。

sentences.en: BECRA distills symbolic strategy lessons that support in-context planning on unseen datasets, enabling zero-shot training adaptation.
sentences.zh: BECRA 提炼出符号化的策略经验，这些经验支持在未见过的数据集上进行上下文内规划，从而实现零样本训练适应。

title_en: Both Semantics and Reconstruction Matter: Making Representation Encoders Ready for Text-to-Image Generation and Editing
title_zh: 语义与重建同样重要：使表征编码器适用于文生图与图像编辑

sentences.en: Modern Latent Diffusion Models (LDMs) typically operate in low-level Variational Autoencoder (VAE) latent spaces that are primarily optimized for pixel-level reconstruction.
sentences.zh: 现代的潜在扩散模型（Latent Diffusion Model，LDM）通常主要用于像素级重建优化的低层变分自编码器（Variational Autoencoder，VAE）潜在空间中运作。

sentences.en: To unify vision generation and understanding, a burgeoning trend is to adopt high-dimensional features from representation encoders as generative latents.
sentences.zh: 为统一视觉生成与理解，一个蓬勃发展的趋势是采用表示编码器的高维特征作为生成潜在表示。

sentences.en: However, we empirically identify two fundamental obstacles in this paradigm: (1) the discriminative feature space lacks compact regularization, making diffusion models prone to off-manifold latents that lead to inaccurate object structures; and (2) the encoder’s inherently weak pixel-level reconstruction hinders the generator from learning accurate fine-grained geometry and texture.
sentences.zh: 然而，我们通过实证在这个范式中识别出两个根本障碍：（1）判别式特征空间缺乏紧凑的正则化，使扩散模型容易产生偏离流形的潜在表示，从而导致目标结构不准确；（2）编码器固有的、较弱的像素级重建阻碍生成器学习精确的细粒度几何与纹理。

sentences.en: In this paper, we propose a systematic framework to adapt understanding-oriented encoder features for generative tasks.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们提出了一个系统性的框架，将面向理解的编码器特征适配到生成任务中。

sentences.en: We introduce a semantic–pixel reconstruction objective to regularize the latent space, enabling the compression of both semantic information and fine-grained details into a highly compact representation (96 channels with $16\times$ spatial downsampling).
sentences.zh: 我们引入了一个语义—像素重建目标来正则化潜在空间，使语义信息和细粒度细节都能被压缩到一个高度紧凑的表示中（96 个通道，$16\times$ 空间下采样）。

sentences.en: This design allows the latent space to remain semantically rich while achieving state-of-the-art image reconstruction, and keeps it compact enough for accurate generation.
sentences.zh: 这一设计使潜在空间既能保持丰富的语义信息、实现最先进的图像重建，又能保持足够紧凑以进行精确生成。

sentences.en: Leveraging this representation, we design a unified text-to-image (T2I) and image editing model.
sentences.zh: 借助这种表示，我们设计了一个统一的文生图（text-to-image，T2I）与图像编辑模型。

sentences.en: Across diverse generation spaces, our approach achieves state-of-the-art reconstruction, faster convergence, and substantial gains in both T2I and editing tasks, demonstrating that representation encoders can be effectively adapted into robust generative components.
sentences.zh: 在多种生成空间中，我们的方法实现了最先进的重建、更快的收敛，并在 T2I 和编辑任务上取得了显著的提升，这表明表示编码器可以被有效地适配为稳健的生成组件。

title_en: Bottleneck Communication Delay Minimization for Communication-Efficient Decentralized Learning
title_zh: 最小化瓶颈通信延迟以实现通信高效的去中心化学习

sentences.en: For communication-efficient decentralized learning, advanced network (NW) topologies, such as exponential and 1-peer exponential graphs, have been studied under homogeneous communication delays.
sentences.zh: 对于通信高效的去中心化学习，先进的网络（Network，NW）拓扑结构（如指数图和单邻居指数图）已在齐次通信延迟下得到研究。

sentences.en: However, real-world NWs exhibit heterogeneous communication delays, making node assignment optimization crucial for minimizing the Bottleneck Communication Delay (BCD).
sentences.zh: 然而，真实世界的网络表现出异构的通信延迟，这使得节点分配优化对最小化瓶颈通信延迟（Bottleneck Communication Delay，BCD）至关重要。

sentences.en: We propose BTSP-MSR, an approximate method for minimizing BCD on circulant digraphs, including exponential and 1-peer exponential graphs.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了 BTSP-MSR，一种在循环有向图中（包括指数图和单邻居指数图）最小化 BCD 的近似方法。

sentences.en: Leveraging the fact that circulant digraphs can be viewed as a union of (directed) ring graphs, we derive an upper bound on the BCD by combining the ring-graph BCD (BTSP) with a deviation term (MSR).
sentences.zh: 利用循环有向图可以看作（有向）环图之并这一事实，我们通过将环图 BCD（BTSP）与一个偏差项（MSR）相结合，推导出 BCD 的一个上界。

sentences.en: We then construct a solver that sequentially minimizes these two terms.
sentences.zh: 随后，我们构建了一个求解器，依次最小化这两个项。

sentences.en: Numerical experiments show that BTSP-MSR consistently reduces BCD across several circulant digraphs with large numbers of nodes.
sentences.zh: 数值实验表明，BTSP-MSR 在多个具有大量节点的循环有向图上持续降低 BCD。

sentences.en: Notably, incorporating the exponential or 1-peer exponential graph enables communication-efficient decentralized learning under heterogeneous delay settings.
sentences.zh: 值得注意的是，引入指数图或单邻居指数图可以在异构延迟设置下实现通信高效的去中心化学习。

title_en: Bottleneck-Guided Spectral Subgoals For Offline Goal-Conditioned RL
title_zh: 用于离线目标条件强化学习的瓶颈引导谱子目标

sentences.en: Offline goal-conditioned RL (OGCRL) learns to reach arbitrary goals from the offline dataset, but long-horizon performance hinges on crossing a handful of hard-to-cross bottlenecks.
sentences.zh: 离线目标条件强化学习（Offline Goal-Conditioned RL，OGCRL）从离线数据集中学习到达任意目标，但长时程性能取决于能否跨越少数几个难以跨越的瓶颈。

sentences.en: These bottlenecks not only dictate the feasible paths toward the goal but also act as critical keypoints, marking the transitions between adjacent regions and providing the agent with essential directional guidance.
sentences.zh: 这些瓶颈不仅决定了通向目标的可行路径，而且还充当关键点（keypoints），标定相邻区域之间的转移，并为智能体提供必要的方向性引导。

sentences.en: Prior hierarchical methods pick subgoals by time or short-horizon value heuristics, which do not localize the bottleneck, and therefore the agent loses the clear guidance that bottlenecks could provide about where to pass next.
sentences.zh: 先前的分层方法按照时间或短时程价值启发式来挑选子目标，这些方法无法定位瓶颈，因此智能体会失去瓶颈所能提供的、关于下一步该往哪里通过的清晰引导。

sentences.en: We instead model long-horizon planning as ``cross the next bottleneck'': we apply Laplacian spectral clustering to the offline dataset to expose bottlenecks, identify trajectories from the offline dataset that cross these boundaries, and use the corresponding boundary-supported states as keypoint (KP) candidates.
sentences.zh: 相反，我们将长时程规划建模为“跨越下一个瓶颈”（cross the next bottleneck）：我们对离线数据集应用拉普拉斯谱聚类以暴露瓶颈，识别离线数据集中跨越这些边界的轨迹，并将相应的、由边界支持的中间状态用作关键点（Keypoint，KP）候选。

sentences.en: The most representative KPs are then instantiated from these candidates, and a directed KP reachability graph $\mathcal G_{\mathrm{KP}}$ is constructed based on the resulting KPs.
sentences.zh: 随后，从这些候选中实例化最具代表性的 KP，并基于由此得到的 KP 构建一个 KP 有向可达图 $\mathcal G_{{\mathrm{KP}}}$。

sentences.en: We then restrict high-level choices to these bottleneck states and use a pluggable low-level controller to execute the short transitions between them.
sentences.zh: 然后，我们将高层选择限制在这些瓶颈状态上，并使用一个可插拔的低层控制器来执行它们之间的短距离转移。

sentences.en: We provide theory showing that under a standard metastable decomposition of the state space, routing through bottlenecks yields an (approximately) optimal one-step subgoal in terms of hitting-time,  and that Laplacian spectra recover bottlenecks with high overlap.
sentences.zh: 我们提供的理论表明，在状态空间的标准亚稳态分解下，经由瓶颈路由在命中时间（hitting-time）意义上能够产生（近似）最优的一步子目标，并且拉普拉斯谱能够以高度重叠的方式恢复瓶颈。

sentences.en: Thus, Laplacian spectral clustering can discover near-optimal subgoals under these assumptions.
sentences.zh: 因此，在这些假设下，拉普拉斯谱聚类可以发现近似最优的子目标。

sentences.en: Empirically, the same pattern holds: across D4RL and OGBench, our method achieves state-of-the-art results on a broad set of navigation and manipulation tasks and across diverse dataset regimes, for example, **96.5\%** on **AntMaze** and **84.7\%** on **Franka-Kitchen**.
sentences.zh: 实证结果表明，同样的规律依然成立：在 D4RL 和 OGBench 上，我们的方法在一系列广泛的导航与操作任务以及多种数据集设置下取得了最先进的结果，例如在 **AntMaze** 上达到 **96.5\%**，在 **Franka-Kitchen** 上达到 **84.7\%**。

authors.name: Zilin Cao
authors.institution: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology

title_en: Boundary Embedding Shaping with Adaptive Contrastive Learning for Graph Structural Disentanglement
title_zh: 结合自适应对比学习塑造边界嵌入以解耦图结构

sentences.en: Graph neural networks (GNNs) excel at aggregating neighbor information for classification, yet their performance is hindered by graph structural entanglement, where spurious correlations from semantically irrelevant neighbors contaminate node embeddings.
sentences.zh: 图神经网络（Graph Neural Network，GNN）擅长为分类而聚合邻居信息，但它们的性能会受到图结构纠缠的阻碍——来自语义无关邻居的虚假相关性会污染节点嵌入。

sentences.en: This challenge is most acute for nodes near class boundaries in the embedding space, where amplified structural noise blurs decision boundaries and destabilizes predictions.
sentences.zh: 这一挑战对于嵌入空间中靠近类别边界的节点最为严重，在该处被放大的结构噪声会模糊决策边界并使预测不稳定。

sentences.en: Existing robust GNN methods largely treat all nodes uniformly, ignoring boundary vulnerabilities.
sentences.zh: 现有的稳健 GNN 方法大多对所有节点一视同仁，忽视了边界脆弱性。

sentences.en: In this paper, to improve classification performance, we tackle graph structural disentanglement by identifying boundary-region entanglement as the primary bottleneck and propose Boundary Embedding Shaping (BES), an adaptive contrastive learning GNN plug-in module that selectively suppresses spurious structural noise at decision boundaries with minimal model parameter perturbation.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，为提升分类性能，我们通过将边界区域纠缠识别为主要瓶颈来应对图结构解纠缠，并提出边界嵌入塑形（Boundary Embedding Shaping，BES）——一个自适应对比学习 GNN 插件模块，它能在对模型参数扰动最小的情况下，选择性地抑制决策边界处的虚假结构噪声。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments demonstrate that BES consistently improves boundary discrimination and outperforms existing leading methods.
sentences.zh: 大量实验表明，BES 持续提升边界判别能力，并优于现有的领先方法。

sentences.en: Notably, BES boosts GCN performance by an average of 3.3% in node classification (up to 5.0% on WikiCS) and achieves superior accuracy in link prediction.
sentences.zh: 值得注意的是，BES 将 GCN 在节点分类中的性能平均提升了 3.3%（在 WikiCS 上最高可达 5.0%），并在链路预测中取得了更高的准确率。

authors.name: Javen Qinfeng Shi
authors.institution: Responsible AI Research Centre, Adelaide University

title_en: Bounded Hyperbolic Tangent: A Stable and Efficient Alternative to Pre-Layer Normalization in Large Language Models
title_zh: 有界双曲正切：大语言模型中预层归一化的稳定高效替代方案

sentences.en: Pre-Layer Normalization (Pre-LN) is the de facto choice for large language models (LLMs) and is crucial for stable pretraining and effective transfer learning.
sentences.zh: 前置层归一化（Pre-Layer Normalization，Pre-LN）是大语言模型（Large Language Model，LLM）的事实上标准选择，对稳定的预训练和有效的迁移学习至关重要。

sentences.en: However, Pre-LN incurs repeated statistical-computation overhead and remains vulnerable to the curse of depth, where hidden-state magnitudes and variances grow as the number of layers increases, destabilizing training.
sentences.zh: 然而，Pre-LN 会产生重复的统计计算开销，并且仍然容易受到深度诅咒的影响——随着层数增加，隐藏状态的幅度和方差会增大，从而使训练不稳定。

sentences.en: Efficiency-oriented normalization-free methods such as Dynamic Tanh (DyT) improve throughput but remain fragile at depth.
sentences.zh: 面向效率的免归一化方法（如 Dynamic Tanh，DyT）能够提升吞吐量，但在深层仍然很脆弱。

sentences.en: To jointly address stability and efficiency, we propose Bounded Hyperbolic Tanh (BHyT), a drop-in replacement for Pre-LN.
sentences.zh: 为同时解决稳定性与效率问题，我们提出了有界双曲正切（Bounded Hyperbolic Tanh，BHyT），它是 Pre-LN 的直接替代品。

sentences.en: BHyT combines a tanh nonlinearity with explicit, data-driven input bounding to keep activations within a non-saturating range.
sentences.zh: BHyT 将 tanh 非线性与显式的、数据驱动的输入有界化相结合，使激活保持在非饱和范围内。

sentences.en: It prevents depth-wise growth in activation magnitude and variance and provides a theoretical stability guarantee.
sentences.zh: 它能够防止激活幅度和方差随深度增长，并提供理论上的稳定性保证。

sentences.en: For efficiency, BHyT computes exact statistics once per block and replaces a second normalization with a lightweight variance approximation.
sentences.zh: 为提高效率，BHyT 每个模块只计算一次精确的统计量，并用一个轻量级的方差近似来代替第二次归一化。

sentences.en: Empirically, BHyT demonstrates improved stability and efficiency during pretraining, achieving an average of 1.6\% faster training and an average of 1.77\% higher token generation throughput compared to RMSNorm, while maintaining strong pretraining-only and post-SFT performance across language understanding and reasoning benchmarks\footnote{Code is available at: \url{https://github.com/MLAI-Yonsei/BHyT}}.
sentences.zh: 实证表明，BHyT 在预训练期间展现出更优的稳定性和效率：与 RMSNorm 相比，训练速度平均提升 1.6\%，token 生成吞吐量平均提升 1.77\%，同时在语言理解和推理基准上保持强大的仅预训练及 SFT 后的性能\footnote{Code is available at: \url{https://github.com/MLAI-Yonsei/BHyT}}。

topic: General Machine Learning->Online Learning, Active Learning and Bandits
title_en: Box Thirding: Anytime Best Arm Identification under Insufficient Sampling
title_zh: Box Thirding：采样不足时的任意时刻最优臂识别

sentences.en: We introduce Box Thirding (B3), a flexible and efficient algorithm for Best Arm Identification (BAI) under fixed budget constraints.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了 Box Thirding（B3），一种在固定预算约束下进行最优臂识别（Best Arm Identification，BAI）的灵活且高效的算法。

sentences.en: It is designed for both anytime BAI and scenarios with large  $N$, where the number of arms is too large for exhaustive evaluation within a limited budget  $T$.
sentences.zh: 它既适用于任意时间的 BAI，也适用于 $N$ 很大的场景——当臂的数量过大，无法在有限预算 $T$ 内进行穷尽式评估时。

sentences.en: The algorithm employs a Remedian Estimation strategy: in each iteration, three arms are compared—the best-performing arm is explored further, the median is retained for future comparisons, and the weakest is discarded.
sentences.zh: 该算法采用了中位数递推估计（Remedian Estimation）策略：在每轮迭代中，会比较三支臂——表现最好的臂会被进一步探索，中位数被保留用于后续比较，而最弱的臂则被丢弃。

sentences.en: Even without prior knowledge of  $T$, B3 achieves an  $\epsilon$ -best arm misidentification probability comparable to Sequential Halving, which requires $T$ as a prior, applied to a randomly selected subset of  $c_0$ arms that fit within the budget.
sentences.zh: 即使对 $T$ 一无所知，B3 也能实现与 Sequential Halving 相当的 $\epsilon$-最优臂误识别概率；而 Sequential Halving 需要以 $T$ 为先验，并应用于预算范围内随机选择的一个子集共 $c_0$ 支臂。

sentences.en: Empirical results show that B3 outperforms existing methods for the limited budget constraint in terms of simple regret, as demonstrated on the New Yorker Cartoon Caption Contest dataset.
sentences.zh: 实证结果表明，在有限预算约束下，B3 在简单遗憾（simple regret）方面优于现有方法，这一点已在 New Yorker Cartoon Caption Contest 数据集上得到验证。

title_en: BPDQ: Bit-Plane Decomposition Quantization on a Variable Grid for Large Language Models
title_zh: BPDQ：基于可变网格的大语言模型比特平面分解量化

sentences.en: Large language model inference is often bounded by memory footprint and bandwidth in resource-constrained deployments, making quantization fundamental to efficient serving.
sentences.zh: 在资源受限的部署中，大语言模型的推理常常受限于内存占用和带宽，这使得量化成为高效服务的基础。

sentences.en: While post-training quantization (PTQ) maintains high fidelity at 4-bit, it deteriorates at 2-3 bits.
sentences.zh: 事后训练量化（Post-Training Quantization，PTQ）在 4 比特下能保持较高的保真度，但在 2 至 3 比特时性能会恶化。

sentences.en: In essence, existing methods enforce a shape-invariant quantization grid (e.g., the fixed uniform intervals of UINT2) for each group, severely restricting the feasible set for error minimization.
sentences.zh: 本质上，现有方法对每个组强制使用形状不变的量化网格（例如 UINT2 的固定均匀区间），这严重限制了用于误差最小化的可行集合。

sentences.en: To address this, we propose Bit-Plane Decomposition Quantization (BPDQ), which constructs a variable quantization grid via bit-planes and scalar coefficients, and iteratively refines them using second-order information while progressively compensating for quantization errors to minimize output discrepancy.
sentences.zh: 为解决这一问题，我们提出了位平面分解量化（Bit-Plane Decomposition Quantization，BPDQ），它通过位平面和标量系数构建可变量化网格，并利用二阶信息迭代地优化这些系数，同时逐步补偿量化误差，以最小化输出偏差。

sentences.en: In the 2-bit regime, BPDQ enables serving Qwen2.5-72B on a single RTX 3090 with 83.85\% GSM8K accuracy (vs. 90.83\% at 16-bit).
sentences.zh: 在 2 比特场景下，BPDQ 使得 Qwen2.5-72B 能够在单张 RTX 3090 上提供服务，GSM8K 准确率达到 83.85\%（而 16 比特时为 90.83\%）。

sentences.en: Moreover, we theoretically show that the variable grid expands the feasible set, and that the quantization process consistently aligns with the optimization objective in Hessian-induced geometry.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们从理论上表明，可变网格扩大了可行集合，并且量化过程在 Hessian 诱导的几何中始终与优化目标保持一致。

sentences.en: The code is available at github.com/KingdalfGoodman/BPDQ.
sentences.zh: 代码可在 github.com/KingdalfGoodman/BPDQ 获取。

title_en: BPL: Generalizable Deepfake Detection via Bias-only Pair-aware Learning
title_zh: BPL：通过仅偏置参数的配对感知学习实现可泛化的深度伪造检测

sentences.en: The detection of synthetic images has traditionally been framed as a binary classification problem.
sentences.zh: 合成图像的检测历来被形式化为一个二分类问题。

sentences.en: However, we argue that this formulation overlooks a fundamental structural property of generative datasets: synthetic images are not independent samples, but are implicitly paired with real images sharing the same semantic source.
sentences.zh: 然而，我们认为这种形式化忽视了生成数据集的一个根本结构特性：合成图像并不是独立样本，而是与具有相同语义来源的真实图像隐式成对的。

sentences.en: Existing methods treat real and fake images as independent instances, failing to capture generation-induced relational discrepancies in real–fake pairs.
sentences.zh: 现有方法将真实图像与伪造图像视为独立实例，无法捕捉生成过程在真实—伪造图像对中引起的关联性差异。

sentences.en: Moreover, models tend to rapidly overfit to seen fake patterns, leading to poor generalization to unseen ones.
sentences.zh: 此外，模型往往会迅速过拟合到已见过的伪造模式，导致对未见模式的泛化能力较差。

sentences.en: To overcome these challenges, we propose a novel detection framework that explicitly mines real–fake pairs by constructing source-guided mappings or leveraging nearest-neighbor relationships in the CLIP embedding space.
sentences.zh: 为克服这些挑战，我们提出了一个新的检测框架，通过构建源引导映射或利用 CLIP 嵌入空间中的最近邻关系，显式地挖掘真实—伪造图像对。

sentences.en: We then introduce pair-wise discrepancy learning that explicitly enlarges generation-induced deviations and discrepancy inversion to mitigate overfitting.
sentences.zh: 随后，我们引入成对差异学习，以显式放大生成引起的偏差，并通过差异反转来缓解过拟合。

sentences.en: Moreover, to preserve pretrained semantic representations while improving generalization, we adopt a bias-only fine-tuning scheme that restricts model capacity during adaptation.
sentences.zh: 此外，为在提升泛化能力的同时保留预训练的语义表示，我们采用了一种仅偏置微调（bias-only fine-tuning）方案，在适配期间限制模型的容量。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments show that our approach achieves superior generalization across unseen fake patterns.
sentences.zh: 大量实验表明，我们的方法在未见过的伪造模式上实现了更优的泛化能力。

authors.name: Xiaoyan Wang
authors.institution: Information Technology Service Center of People's Court

title_en: Brain Networks Should Be Learned, Not Constructed
title_zh: 脑网络应当学习得到，而非人为构建

sentences.en: The construction of the brain functional network often follows the hand-crafted Correlation Coefficients without any learnable components.
sentences.zh: 脑功能网络的构建通常遵循手工设计的相关系数（Correlation Coefficients），其中没有任何可学习的组件。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, most efforts are made to the models, such as graph neural networks, that make predictions with the constructed brain network as input.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，大部分努力都集中在模型上，例如图神经网络，它们以构建好的脑网络作为输入来进行预测。

sentences.en: Unfortunately, the fixed brain network may lose critical information during construction and lead to difficulty in performance improvement, even with deliberately designed graph models.
sentences.zh: 遗憾的是，固定的脑网络可能在构建过程中丢失关键信息，即使使用精心设计的图模型，也难以提升性能。

sentences.en: From this perspective, the current situation is similar to the machine learning community, i.e., hand-crafted features and learnable predictors, before the advent of representation learning.
sentences.zh: 从这个角度来看，当前的情况类似于表示学习出现之前的机器学习领域，即手工特征加上可学习的预测器。

sentences.en: In fact, the brain network can be regarded as a graph-structured learnable representation of the brain.
sentences.zh: 事实上，脑网络可以被视为大脑的一种图结构的可学习表示。

sentences.en: By drawing on representation learning, this paper presents the Brain Representation (BRep) learning problem.
sentences.zh: 借鉴表示学习的思想，本文提出了大脑表示（BRep）学习问题。

sentences.en: To this end, the widely used linear and nonlinear correlations are enhanced to be high-order, parametric, and learnable.
sentences.zh: 为此，本文将广泛使用的线性和非线性相关性增强为高阶、参数化且可学习的形式。

sentences.en: The expressive brain representation shifts the heavy computational burden away from downstream architectures, enabling a simple yet accurate predictor.
sentences.zh: 这种富有表现力的脑表示将沉重的计算负担从下游架构中转移出来，使得一个简单而准确的预测器成为可能。

sentences.en: Theoretical analysis guarantees the model's universal approximation to any U/V-statistics.
sentences.zh: 理论分析保证了模型对任意 U/V 统计量（U/V-statistics）的通用逼近能力。

sentences.en: Extensive evaluations demonstrate that BRep possesses superior performance, high efficiency, and interpretability.
sentences.zh: 广泛的评估表明，BRep 具有优越的性能、高效率和可解释性。

sentences.en: The code is available at https://github.com/Kevin-916/BRep-demo/.
sentences.zh: 代码可在 https://github.com/Kevin-916/BRep-demo/ 获取。

title_en: BrainJanus: A Unified Model for Understanding and Generation across Brain, Vision, and Language
title_zh: BrainJanus：跨大脑、视觉与语言的理解和生成统一模型

sentences.en: Modeling the bidirectional correspondence between external sensory stimuli and internal neural activity has emerged as a critical frontier in neuroscience.
sentences.zh: 对外部感觉刺激与内部神经活动之间双向对应关系的建模，已成为神经科学的一个关键前沿。

sentences.en: However, existing approaches predominantly treat brain encoding and decoding as isolated tasks, relying heavily on unimodal alignment and external priors while overlooking the brain's intrinsic nature as a multimodal integration system.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有方法大多将脑编码和脑解码视为彼此孤立的任务，严重依赖单模态对齐和外部先验，却忽略了大脑作为多模态整合系统的内在本质。

sentences.en: To address these limitations, we propose BrainJanus, the first unified brain model that integrates brain, vision, and language within a single framework.
sentences.zh: 为解决这些局限，我们提出了 BrainJanus——首个将脑、视觉与语言整合到单一框架中的统一脑模型。

sentences.en: Specifically, we introduce a Unified Brain Tokenizer to quantize continuous neural dynamics into discrete tokens aligned with visual and linguistic representations in a shared Omni space.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，我们引入了一种统一脑分词器（Unified Brain Tokenizer），将连续的神经动态量化为离散的 token，并在共享的 Omni 空间中与视觉和语言表示进行对齐。

sentences.en: Building on this, we utilize an All-in-One autoregressive architecture that leverages next-token prediction to enable seamless any-to-any generation, which encompasses image-to-brain and text-to-brain encoding, and brain-to-image and brain-to-text decoding.
sentences.zh: 在此基础上，我们采用了一种 All-in-One 自回归架构，利用下一 token 预测实现无缝的任意到任意生成，涵盖图像到脑、文本到脑的编码，以及脑到图像、脑到文本的解码。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments demonstrate that BrainJanus achieves superior performance across diverse benchmarks.
sentences.zh: 大量实验表明，BrainJanus 在各种基准上均取得了优越的性能。

sentences.en: Furthermore, our framework exhibits zero-shot generalization and preserves interpretable biological topography, highlighting its potential as a general-purpose brain modeling paradigm.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们的框架展现出零样本泛化能力，并保留了可解释的生物学拓扑结构，凸显了其作为通用脑建模范式的潜力。

sentences.en: The code is available at \href{https://github.com/HaitaoWuTJU/BrainJanus}{GitHub}.
sentences.zh: 代码可在 \href{https://github.com/HaitaoWuTJU/BrainJanus}{GitHub} 获取。

title_en: Branch Scaling Manifests as Implicit Architectural Regularization for Improving Generalization in Overparameterized ResNets
title_zh: 分支缩放表现为隐式架构正则化，改善过参数化残差网络的泛化

sentences.en: Scaling factors in residual branches have emerged as a prevalent method for boosting neural network performance, especially in normalization-free architectures.
sentences.zh: 残差分支中的缩放因子已成为提升神经网络性能的普遍方法，尤其是在无归一化架构中。

sentences.en: While prior work has primarily examined scaling effects from an optimization perspective, this paper investigates their role in residual architectures through the lens of generalization theory.
sentences.zh: 虽然先前的工作主要从优化角度考察缩放的作用，但本文通过泛化理论的视角研究了它们在残差架构中的作用。

sentences.en: Specifically, we establish that wide residual networks (ResNets) with constant scaling factors become asymptotically unlearnable as depth increases.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，我们证明，具有恒定缩放因子的宽残差网络（ResNet）会随着深度的增加而渐近地变得不可学习。

sentences.en: In contrast, when the scaling factor exhibits rapid depth-wise decay combined with early stopping, over-parameterized ResNets achieve minimax-optimal generalization rates.
sentences.zh: 相比之下，当缩放因子随深度快速衰减并结合早停（early stopping）时，过参数化的 ResNet 能够达到极小极大最优（minimax-optimal）的泛化速率。

sentences.en: To establish this, we demonstrate that the generalization capability of wide ResNets can be approximated by the kernel regression associated with a specific kernel.
sentences.zh: 为了证明这一点，我们展示了宽 ResNet 的泛化能力可以由与特定核相关联的核回归来近似。

sentences.en: Our theoretical findings are validated through experiments on synthetic data and real-world classification tasks, including MNIST and CIFAR-100.
sentences.zh: 我们的理论发现通过在合成数据以及包括 MNIST 和 CIFAR-100 在内的真实分类任务上的实验得到了验证。

topic: General Machine Learning->Sequential, Network, and Time Series Modeling
title_en: Branching Diffusion for Point Processes in Time and Space
title_zh: 时空点过程的分支扩散

sentences.en: We propose a non-autoregressive branching diffusion model for generating spatio-temporal point processes.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了一种非自回归的分支扩散模型，用于生成时空点过程。

sentences.en: Starting from a geometric principle---the Wasserstein-Fisher-Rao (WFR) gradient flow of a generalized KL divergence toward a simple reference intensity---we obtain a tractable forward noising mechanism with two interpretable components: (i) a Langevin-type \emph{drift-diffusion} step that perturbs event locations and times, and (ii) a \emph{birth-death branching} step that changes the event count via location-dependent thinning (deaths) and Poisson offspring replication (births).
sentences.zh: 从几何原理出发——即广义 KL 散度朝向简单参考强度的 Wasserstein-Fisher-Rao（WFR）梯度流——我们获得了一个易处理的前向加噪机制，它包含两个可解释的组成部分：(i) 一个 Langevin 型的 \emph{漂移-扩散}（drift-diffusion）步骤，用于扰动事件的位置和时间；(ii) 一个 \emph{生灭分支}（birth-death branching）步骤，通过位置相关的稀疏化（死亡）和泊松子代复制（出生）来改变事件数量。

sentences.en: We learn the reverse-time dynamics using a permutation-equivariant denoiser that predicts a drift field and a net-growth field, and we train it using an entropic-regularized unbalanced optimal transport (UOT), which naturally handles count mismatch between noisy and clean samples.
sentences.zh: 我们使用一个排列等变的去噪器来学习逆向时间动力学，它预测一个漂移场和一个净增长场，并使用熵正则化的非平衡最优传输（UOT）对其进行训练，从而自然地处理带噪样本与干净样本之间的数量不匹配。

sentences.en: The resulting generator produces complete spatio-temporal event sets without autoregressive simulation or explicit intensity normalization.
sentences.zh: 最终得到的生成器能够生成完整的时空事件集合，而无需自回归模拟或显式的强度归一化。

title_en: Break the Block: Dynamic-size Reasoning Blocks for Diffusion Large Language Models via Monotonic Entropy Descent with Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: 打破分块：通过强化学习中的单调熵下降，为扩散大语言模型实现动态大小推理块

sentences.en: Recent diffusion large language models (dLLMs) have demonstrated both effectiveness and efficiency in reasoning via a block-based semi-autoregressive generation paradigm.
sentences.zh: 近期的扩散大语言模型（dLLM）通过基于块的半自回归生成范式，在推理中展现出了既有效又高效的性能。

sentences.en: Despite their progress, the fixed-size block generations remain a critical bottleneck for effective and coherent reasoning.
sentences.zh: 尽管取得了进展，固定尺寸的块生成仍然是实现有效且连贯推理的关键瓶颈。

sentences.en: (I) From a global perspective, different reasoning tasks would correspond to different optimal decoding block sizes, which makes a "one-size-fits-all" assumption ineffective.
sentences.zh: （I）从全局角度看，不同的推理任务对应不同的最优解码块尺寸，这使得“一刀切”（one-size-fits-all）的假设不再有效。

sentences.en: (II) Even within a single reasoning task, the rigid block partitioning would break the logical flow and reduce reasoning coherence.
sentences.zh: （II）即使在单个推理任务内部，僵化的块划分也会破坏逻辑流程并降低推理的连贯性。

sentences.en: Through empirical observations, we reveal that, for block-wise entropy, incorrect reasoning exhibits a fluctuating and unsteady trend between blocks, while the correctly generated tasks follow a consistent descending paradigm.
sentences.zh: 通过实证观察，我们发现在块级熵方面，错误的推理在块之间表现出波动、不稳定的趋势，而正确生成的任务则遵循一致的下降范式。

sentences.en: Therefore, this paper proposes b1, a novel post-training framework that learns dynamic-size reasoning blocks via a Monotonic Entropy Descent objective with reinforcement learning to enhance reasoning coherence. b1 integrates seamlessly as a plug-and-play module with existing dLLM's post-training algorithms.
sentences.zh: 因此，本文提出了 b1——一种新颖的后训练框架，它通过带有强化学习的单调熵下降（Monotonic Entropy Descent）目标来学习动态尺寸的推理块，以增强推理的连贯性。b1 可以作为即插即用的模块，与现有 dLLM 的后训练算法无缝集成。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments across various reasoning benchmarks showcase b1's consistent improvement over fixed-size block baselines.
sentences.zh: 跨多种推理基准的大量实验表明，与固定尺寸块的基线相比，b1 取得了持续一致的改进。

sentences.en: Our code has been released at https://github.com/YanJiangJerry/Block-R1.
sentences.zh: 我们的代码已在 https://github.com/YanJiangJerry/Block-R1 发布。

title_en: Breaking Dual Bottlenecks: Evolving Unified Multimodal Models into Self-Adaptive Interleaved Visual Reasoners
title_zh: 突破双重瓶颈：将统一多模态模型演化为自适应交错视觉推理器

sentences.en: Recent unified models integrate multimodal understanding and generation within a single framework.
sentences.zh: 近期的统一模型将多模态理解与生成整合在单一框架之中。

sentences.en: However, an ``understanding-generation gap'' persists, where models can capture user intent but often fail to translate this semantic knowledge into precise pixel-level manipulation.
sentences.zh: 然而，“理解-生成鸿沟”（understanding-generation gap）依然存在：模型能够捕捉用户意图，却常常无法将这种语义知识转化为精确的像素级操作。

sentences.en: This gap results in two bottlenecks in anything-to-image task~(X2I): the \textbf{attention entanglement bottleneck}, where blind planning struggles with complex prompts, and the \textbf{visual refinement bottleneck}, where unstructured feedback fails to correct imperfections efficiently.
sentences.zh: 这种鸿沟在任意到图像任务（X2I）中造成了两个瓶颈：\textbf{注意力纠缠瓶颈}（attention entanglement bottleneck），即盲目规划难以应对复杂提示；以及 \textbf{视觉细化瓶颈}（visual refinement bottleneck），即非结构化反馈无法高效地修正瑕疵。

sentences.en: In this paper, we propose a novel framework that empowers unified models to autonomously switch between generation strategies based on instruction complexity and model capability.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们提出了一种新颖的框架，使统一模型能够根据指令的复杂度和模型的能力，自主地在不同的生成策略之间切换。

sentences.en: To achieve this, we construct a hierarchical data pipeline that constructs execution paths across three adaptive modes: direct generation for simple cases, self-reflection for quality refinement, and multi-step planning for decomposing complex scenarios.
sentences.zh: 为实现这一目标，我们构建了一条层级化的数据流水线，在三种自适应模式之间构建执行路径：针对简单案例的直接生成、用于质量细化的自我反思，以及用于分解复杂场景的多步规划。

sentences.en: Building on this pipeline, we contribute a high-quality dataset with over 50,000 samples and implement a two-stage training strategy comprising SFT and RL.
sentences.zh: 基于这条流水线，我们贡献了一个包含 50,000 多个样本的高质量数据集，并实现了一种包含 SFT 和 RL 的两阶段训练策略。

sentences.en: Specifically, we design step-wise reasoning rewards to ensure logical consistency and intra-group complexity penalty to prevent redundant computational overhead.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，我们设计了逐步推理奖励以确保逻辑一致性，并设计了组内复杂度惩罚以避免冗余的计算开销。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method outperforms existing baselines on X2I, achieving superior generation fidelity among simple-to-complex instructions.
sentences.zh: 大量实验表明，我们的方法在 X2I 上优于现有基线，在从简单到复杂的指令中均获得了优越的生成保真度。

title_en: Breaking Manifold Continuity: Vector Quantized Modeling for Real-Centric Deepfake Detection
title_zh: 打破流形连续性：面向真实样本中心深度伪造检测的向量量化建模

sentences.en: The increasingly realistic and diverse generative data has led some deepfake detection methods to shift towards learning robust real content, e.g., via reconstruction-based tasks.
sentences.zh: 日益逼真且多样化的生成数据，促使一些深度伪造检测方法转向学习鲁棒的真实内容，例如通过基于重建的任务。

sentences.en: However, most existing approaches rely primarily on prevalent continuous modeling (e.g., GMMs, VAEs, Diffusion Models) to construct a continuous latent manifold of real data, with the aim of improving the generalization capability, while overlooking a critical issue, i.e., such continuity may facilitate the interpolation of forgery artifacts, consequently causing ambiguity in detection.
sentences.zh: 然而，大多数现有方法主要依赖流行的连续建模（例如 GMM、VAE、扩散模型）来构建真实数据的连续潜流形，以期提升泛化能力，却忽略了一个关键问题：这种连续性可能促进伪造痕迹的插值，从而造成检测上的模糊性。

sentences.en: To alleviate this problem, we integrate discrete modeling into the feature space of the CLIP vision encoder, striking a balance between continuous manifold modeling and discrete representation.
sentences.zh: 为缓解这一问题，我们将离散建模整合进 CLIP 视觉编码器的特征空间，在连续流形建模与离散表示之间取得平衡。

sentences.en: By incorporating a learnable vector quantized codebook, the real latent manifold is discretized, imposing a more stringent information bottleneck that reduces the likelihood of embedding generative artifacts.
sentences.zh: 通过引入一个可学习的向量量化码本，真实的潜流形被离散化，从而施加了更严格的信息瓶颈，降低了嵌入生成痕迹的可能性。

sentences.en: In order to further enhance the generalization of discrete modeling, we propose an adaptive tangent space projection mechanism that yields a continuous relaxation of the discrete real distribution within a controllable range.
sentences.zh: 为了进一步增强离散建模的泛化能力，我们提出了一种自适应切空间投影机制，它能在可控范围内对离散的真实分布进行连续松弛。

sentences.en: With these components, our method constructs a real distribution that is both tightly constrained and broadly generalizable, enhancing robustness to unseen forgeries.
sentences.zh: 凭借这些组件，我们的方法构建了一个既受严格约束又具有广泛泛化能力的真实分布，增强了对未见伪造的鲁棒性。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on diverse datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of our method.
sentences.zh: 在多种数据集上的大量实验证明了我们方法的有效性。

title_en: Breaking Multi-Task Curse: Reward-Weighted Evolution for Black-Box Many-Task Optimization
title_zh: 打破多任务诅咒：用于黑盒众多任务优化的奖励加权进化

sentences.en: Evolutionary multi-tasking accelerates black-box optimization via knowledge transfer but falters in scenarios involving many low-similarity tasks.
sentences.zh: 进化多任务处理通过知识迁移加速黑箱优化，但在涉及许多低相似度任务的场景中会表现不佳。

sentences.en: We identify this scalability barrier as the *Multi-Task Curse*, driven by evaluation budget dispersion and negative transfer.
sentences.zh: 我们将这一可扩展性障碍定义为*多任务诅咒*（Multi-Task Curse），其成因是评估预算的分散和负迁移。

sentences.en: To overcome this, we propose MES-RET (*M*any-task *E*volution *S*trategy with *R*eward-weighted *E*valuation and *T*ransfer), which combats budget dispersion via a reward-weighted evaluation scheme that guarantees superior expected improvement, while simultaneously mitigating negative transfer through a robust reward-weighted aggregation of mean and covariance statistics, ensuring a safe fallback to independent evolution.
sentences.zh: 为解决这一问题，我们提出了 MES-RET（带奖励加权评估与迁移的多任务进化策略），它通过一种保证更优期望提升的奖励加权评估方案来对抗预算分散，同时通过均值和协方差统计量的鲁棒奖励加权聚合来缓解负迁移，确保能够安全回退到独立进化。

sentences.en: Furthermore, to handle neural dimensional mismatches in many-task policy search, we introduce a semantic parameter alignment strategy that bridges heterogeneous state-action spaces.
sentences.zh: 此外，为了处理多任务策略搜索中的神经维度不匹配问题，我们引入了一种语义参数对齐策略，用于桥接异构的状态-动作空间。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on synthetic benchmarks, real-world engineering problems, and reinforcement learning tasks demonstrate that MES-RET consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods, notably enabling skill transfer across morphologically distinct policies.
sentences.zh: 在合成基准、真实工程问题以及强化学习任务上的大量实验表明，MES-RET 持续优于最先进的方法，尤其能够实现形态各异的策略之间的技能迁移。

title_en: Breaking the Block: Preserving Data Continuity to Train Superior SAEs for Instruct Models
title_zh: 打破分块：保持数据连续性，为指令模型训练更优的稀疏自编码器

sentences.en: Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) are a cornerstone of mechanistic interpretability.
sentences.zh: 稀疏自编码器（SAE）是机制可解释性的基石。

sentences.en: Existing training methods inherit the Block Training paradigm from LLM pre-training, which introduces destructive gradient noise in instruct models due to attention leakage from unrelated contexts.
sentences.zh: 现有的训练方法继承了 LLM 预训练中的块训练（Block Training）范式，由于不相关上下文带来的注意力泄漏，它会在指令模型中引入破坏性的梯度噪声。

sentences.en: Using GSNR analysis, we theoretically characterize this issue and propose $\underline{\textbf{F}}$inetuning-$\underline{\textbf{a}}$ligned $\underline{\textbf{S}}$equential $\underline{\textbf{T}}$raining ($\textit{FAST}$), a sequential training paradigm specifically designed for instruct models.
sentences.zh: 利用 GSNR 分析，我们从理论上刻画了这一问题，并提出 $\underline{\textbf{F}}inetuning-$\underline{\textbf{a}}ligned $\underline{\textbf{S}}equential $\underline{\textbf{T}}raining（$\textit{FAST}）——一种专门为指令模型设计的顺序训练范式。

sentences.en: $\textit{FAST}$ aligns SAE training with the data distribution and activation patterns of instruct models, substantially improving both reconstruction fidelity and feature interpretability.
sentences.zh: $\textit{FAST} 使 SAE 训练与指令模型的数据分布和激活模式保持一致，显著提升了重建保真度和特征可解释性。

sentences.en: Experimental results show that $\textit{FAST}$ achieves higher GSNR, a significantly lower log-scaled MSE of 0.6468 compared to the baseline’s 5.1985, and a near-zero Delta Loss (-0.51\% to 0.37\%).
sentences.zh: 实验结果表明，$\textit{FAST} 实现了更高的 GSNR，相较于基线的 5.1985，其对数刻度的 MSE 显著降低至 0.6468，且 Delta Loss 接近为零（-0.51\% 至 0.37\%）。

sentences.en: Moreover, on Llama-3.2-3B-it, $\textit{FAST}$ produces 21.1\% high-quality features, substantially outperforming baseline methods that achieve 7.0\% and 10.2\%.
sentences.zh: 此外，在 Llama-3.2-3B-it 上，$\textit{FAST} 生成了 21.1\% 的高质量特征，大幅优于分别达到 7.0\% 和 10.2\% 的基线方法。

sentences.en: We further find that intervening on special token activations through SAEs can improve generation quality, revealing new opportunities for fine-grained control.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步发现，通过 SAE 对特殊 token 的激活进行干预可以提升生成质量，这为细粒度控制开辟了新的机遇。

sentences.en: Our codes are available as open source at https://github.com/Geaming2002/FAST.
sentences.zh: 我们的代码已在 https://github.com/Geaming2002/FAST 开源发布。

title_en: Breaking the Capacity Bottleneck in Model-Heterogeneous Federated Learning via Gradual Model Restoration
title_zh: 通过渐进式模型恢复突破模型异质联邦学习的容量瓶颈

sentences.en: Federated learning (FL) enables distributed model training, yet in heterogeneous deployments, Bandwidth-Constrained Clients (BCCs) often contribute inefficiently due to limited uplink bandwidth.
sentences.zh: 联邦学习（FL）使分布式模型训练成为可能，然而在异构部署中，受带宽约束的客户端（BCC）常常由于上行带宽有限而导致训练效率低下。

sentences.en: In model-heterogeneous FL with fixed small sub-models, BCCs with sub-models may improve quickly in early rounds but become under-parameterized later, resulting in slow convergence and poor generalization.
sentences.zh: 在采用固定小子模型的模型异构联邦学习中，使用子模型的 BCC 可能在早期轮次中提升较快，但后期会因参数不足而导致收敛缓慢、泛化能力差。

sentences.en: To address this challenge, we propose **FedGMR**, a federated learning framework centered around **Gradual Model Restoration (GMR)**, where GMR progressively increases each client’s sub-model density during training, allowing BCCs to remain effective contributors throughout optimization.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一挑战，我们提出了 **FedGMR**——一个以 **渐进式模型恢复（GMR）** 为核心的联邦学习框架，其中 GMR 在训练过程中逐渐提高每个客户端的子模型密度，使 BCC 在整个优化过程中始终保持有效的贡献者角色。

sentences.en: To make GMR practical under real-world heterogeneity, FedGMR is realized as an end-to-end workflow with asynchronous coordination and stable, mask-aware aggregation.
sentences.zh: 为使 GMR 在真实异构环境中具有实用性，FedGMR 被实现为包含异步协调和稳定、掩码感知聚合的端到端工作流。

sentences.en: We further establish convergence guarantees, showing that the aggregation error scales with the **average** sub-model density across clients and rounds, and that GMR provably narrows the gap toward full-model FL.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步建立了收敛性保证，表明聚合误差随各客户端各轮次的**平均**子模型密度而缩放，并且 GMR 可证明地缩小了与全模型联邦学习之间的差距。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on FEMNIST, CIFAR-10, ImageNet-100, and StackOverflow demonstrate that FedGMR improves both convergence speed and final accuracy, especially under severe heterogeneity and non-IID data distributions.
sentences.zh: 在 FEMNIST、CIFAR-10、ImageNet-100 和 StackOverflow 上的大量实验表明，FedGMR 同时提升了收敛速度和最终精度，尤其是在严重异构和非独立同分布（non-IID）数据分布下。

sentences.en: Code is available at https://github.com/machengjie321/ICML2026-FedGMR.
sentences.zh: 代码可在 https://github.com/machengjie321/ICML2026-FedGMR 获取。

title_en: Breaking the Computational Barrier: Provably Efficient Actor–Critic for Low-Rank MDPs
title_zh: 突破计算壁垒：低秩马尔可夫决策过程的可证明高效行动者–评论家方法

sentences.en: Reinforcement learning (RL) is a fundamental framework for sequential decision-making, in which an agent learns an optimal policy through interactions with an unknown environment.
sentences.zh: 强化学习（RL）是序列决策的基本框架，代理通过与未知环境的交互来学习最优策略。

sentences.en: In settings with function approximation, many existing RL algorithms achieve favorable sample complexity, but often rely on computationally intractable oracles.
sentences.zh: 在函数逼近的设置中，许多现有的 RL 算法能够实现良好的样本复杂度，但常常依赖计算上难以处理的 oracle。

sentences.en: In this paper, we use supervised learning as a computational proxy to establish a clear hierarchy of commonly adopted RL oracles under low-rank Markov Decision Processes (MDPs).
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们使用监督学习作为计算代理，在低秩马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）下为常用的 RL oracle 建立了清晰的层级结构。

sentences.en: This hierarchy shows that policy evaluation is the most computationally efficient oracle, provided that supervised learning can be efficiently solved.
sentences.zh: 该层级表明，只要能高效求解监督学习，策略评估就是计算上最高效的 oracle。

sentences.en: Motivated by this observation, we propose a novel optimistic actor–critic algorithm that relies solely on the policy evaluation oracle.
sentences.zh: 受此观察启发，我们提出了一种仅依赖策略评估 oracle 的新型乐观 actor–critic 算法。

sentences.en: We prove that our algorithm outperforms the existing sample complexity guarantees for low-rank MDPs while avoiding computationally expensive planning or optimization oracles commonly assumed in prior works.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，我们的算法超越了低秩 MDP 现有的样本复杂度保证，同时避免了先前工作中常假设的计算代价高昂的规划或优化 oracle。

sentences.en: We further extend our theoretical results to approximately low-rank MDPs and demonstrate that this setting captures a broad class of real-world environments.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步将理论结果扩展到近似低秩 MDP，并证明该设定能够涵盖广泛的真实世界环境。

sentences.en: Finally, we validate our theoretical results with experiments on several standard Gym benchmarks.
sentences.zh: 最后，我们在多个标准 Gym 基准上通过实验验证了我们的理论结果。

title_en: Breaking the Echo Chamber: A Dynamic Ensemble Pruning Perspective on MoE
title_zh: 打破回音室：从动态集成剪枝视角理解混合专家模型

sentences.en: We introduce Mahalanobis-Pruned Mixture-of-Experts (MP-MoE), a novel routing framework that approaches expert selection from the perspective of ensemble pruning.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了 Mahalanobis 剪枝混合专家（MP-MoE）——一种新颖的路由框架，它从集成剪枝的角度来处理专家选择问题。

sentences.en: Existing Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) routing strategies often suffer from representation collapse due to greedy top-k selection mechanisms or rely on complex auxiliary regularization terms that may compromise model performance.
sentences.zh: 现有的混合专家（MoE）路由策略常常因贪婪的 top-k 选择机制而遭受表示坍缩，或者依赖可能损害模型性能的复杂辅助正则化项。

sentences.en: To address these issues, we formulate routing as a diversity-aware subset selection problem and optimize a Mahalanobis-distance-based objective that explicitly enhances expert diversity.
sentences.zh: 为解决这些问题，我们将路由建模为一个多样性感知的子集选择问题，并优化一个基于 Mahalanobis 距离的目标，以显式增强专家多样性。

sentences.en: Specifically, we demonstrate that the expert co-occurrence matrix effectively captures inter-expert correlations, allowing us to efficiently model the covariance structure required for distance computation without accessing expert parameters.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，我们表明专家共现矩阵能够有效捕获专家间的相关性，使我们无需访问专家参数即可高效建模距离计算所需的协方差结构。

sentences.en: Furthermore, we devise a greedy strategy for the routing mechanism, backed by theoretical approximation guarantees, rendering it a plug-and-play module with negligible overhead.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们为路由机制设计了一种贪婪策略，并辅以理论近似保证，使其成为一个几乎无需额外开销的即插即用模块。

sentences.en: MP-MoE increases wall-clock training time by approximately 3\%, while incurring no additional latency at inference time.
sentences.zh: MP-MoE 使训练墙钟时间增加约 3\%，同时在推理阶段不引入任何额外延迟。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments demonstrate that during the pre-training of the large language model, our method consistently outperforms the baseline by 1-3 percentage points across a broad range of benchmarks.
sentences.zh: 大量实验表明，在大语言模型的预训练过程中，我们的方法在广泛的基准上持续超越基线 1-3 个百分点。

title_en: Breaking the Exploration Bottleneck: Rubric-Scaffolded Reinforcement Learning for Open-Ended LLM Reasoning
title_zh: 突破探索瓶颈：用于开放式大语言模型推理的评分准则支架强化学习

sentences.en: Recent advances in Large Language Models (LLMs) have underscored the potential of Reinforcement Learning (RL) to facilitate the emergence of reasoning capabilities.
sentences.zh: 大语言模型（LLM）的最新进展突显了强化学习（RL）促进推理能力浮现的潜力。

sentences.en: Despite the encouraging results, a fundamental dilemma persists as RL improvement relies on learning from high-quality samples, yet the exploration for such samples remains bounded by the inherent limitations of LLMs.
sentences.zh: 尽管结果令人鼓舞，但一个根本性的困境依然存在：RL 的提升依赖于从高质量样本中学习，而对这类样本的探索仍然受限于 LLM 自身的固有短板。

sentences.en: This, in effect, creates an undesirable cycle in which what cannot be explored cannot be learned.
sentences.zh: 这实际上形成了一个不良循环：无法被探索的，也就无法被学习。

sentences.en: In this work, we propose Rubric-Scaffolded Reinforcement Learning (RuscaRL), a novel instructional scaffolding framework designed to break the exploration bottleneck for open-ended reasoning.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们提出了评分量表脚手架强化学习（RuscaRL）——一种新颖的指令脚手架框架，旨在打破开放式推理中的探索瓶颈。

sentences.en: Specifically, RuscaRL introduces checklist-style rubrics as (1) explicit scaffolding for exploration during rollout generation, where different rubrics are provided as external guidance within task instructions to steer diverse high-quality responses.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，RuscaRL 引入了清单式评分量表，作为（1）rollout 生成阶段的显式探索脚手架：在任务指令中提供不同的量表作为外部引导，以催生出多样化的高质量回答。

sentences.en: This guidance is gradually decayed over time, encouraging the model to internalize the underlying reasoning patterns; (2) verifiable rewards for exploitation during model training, where we can obtain robust LLM-as-a-Judge scores using rubrics as references, enabling effective RL on open-ended reasoning tasks.
sentences.zh: 这种引导会随时间的推移逐渐衰减，促使模型内化潜在的推理模式；（2）模型训练阶段可用于利用（exploitation）的可验证奖励：我们可以以评分量表为参考获得稳健的 LLM 作为裁判（LLM-as-a-Judge）的评分，从而在开放式推理任务上实现有效的 RL。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments demonstrate the superiority of the proposed RuscaRL across various benchmarks, effectively expanding reasoning boundaries under the Best-of-N evaluation.
sentences.zh: 大量实验表明，所提出的 RuscaRL 在各种基准上均表现出优越性，并在 Best-of-N 评估下有效拓展了推理边界。

title_en: Breaking the Factorization Barrier in Diffusion Language Models
title_zh: 突破扩散语言模型的因子分解壁垒

sentences.en: Diffusion language models theoretically allow for efficient parallel generation but are practically hindered by the "factorization barrier": the assumption that simultaneously predicted tokens are independent.
sentences.zh: 扩散语言模型在理论上允许高效的并行生成，但在实践中却受到“因子化壁垒”的阻碍：即假设同时预测的 token 之间相互独立。

sentences.en: This limitation forces a trade-off: models must either sacrifice speed by resolving dependencies sequentially or suffer from incoherence due to factorization.
sentences.zh: 这一局限造成了权衡：模型要么通过依序求解依赖关系而牺牲速度，要么因因子化而遭受不连贯性。

sentences.en: We argue that this barrier arises not from limited backbone expressivity, but from a structural misspecification: models are restricted to fully factorized outputs because explicitly parameterizing a joint distribution would require the Transformer to output a prohibitively large number of parameters.
sentences.zh: 我们认为，这一壁垒并非源于骨干网络表达能力的局限，而是源于结构上的错误设定：模型被限制为完全因子化的输出，因为显式参数化联合分布将要求 Transformer 输出数量极为庞大的参数。

sentences.en: We propose **Co**upled **D**iscrete **D**iffusion (**CoDD**), a hybrid framework that breaks this barrier by replacing the fully-factorized output distribution with a lightweight, tractable probabilistic inference layer.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了 **协同离散扩散**（**CoDD**）——一个通过用轻量、易处理的概率推理层替换完全因子化输出分布来打破这一壁垒的混合框架。

sentences.en: This formulation yields a distribution family that is significantly more expressive than standard factorized priors, enabling the modeling of complex joint dependencies, yet remains compact enough to avoid the prohibitive parameter explosion associated with full joint modeling.
sentences.zh: 这种构造产生了一族显著比标准因子化先验更具表达力的分布，既能够建模复杂的联合依赖关系，又足够紧凑，从而避免了与完整联合建模相关的参数爆炸。

sentences.en: Empirically, CoDD seamlessly enhances diverse diffusion language model architectures with negligible overhead, matching the reasoning performance of computationally intensive Reinforcement Learning baselines at a fraction of the training cost.
sentences.zh: 在实验上，CoDD 以可忽略的开销无缝增强了多种扩散语言模型架构，以极低的训练成本匹配了计算密集的强化学习基线的推理性能。

sentences.en: Furthermore, it prevents performance collapse in few-step generation, enabling high-quality outputs at significantly reduced latencies.
sentences.zh: 此外，它还能防止少步生成中的性能崩溃，在显著降低延迟的同时产出高质量的输出。

sentences.en: Code available at: https://github.com/liuanji/CoDD
sentences.zh: 代码可在 https://github.com/liuanji/CoDD 获取。

title_en: Breaking the Lock-in: Diversifying Text-to-Image Generation via Representation Modulation
title_zh: 打破锁定：通过表征调制实现多样化文生图

sentences.en: Recent text-to-image models built on large-scale Transformer backbones and flow-based objectives deliver strong text–image alignment and high visual quality, yet often produce overly similar samples under a fixed prompt.
sentences.zh: 近期基于大规模 Transformer 骨干与流（flow）式目标构建的文生图模型带来了强大的文本-图像对齐能力和高质量的视觉效果，但在固定提示词下往往生成过于相似的样本。

sentences.en: Existing diversity-enhancement methods alleviate this, but typically require expensive sampling or auxiliary optimization, incurring non-trivial overhead.
sentences.zh: 现有的多样性增强方法虽能缓解这一问题，但通常需要昂贵的采样或辅助优化，带来不小的开销。

sentences.en: To investigate the root cause of this homogeneity, we examine intermediate Transformer features and observe that the zero-frequency spatial average (DC) component rapidly converges across seeds early in generation, causing early trajectory lock-in that limits downstream variation.
sentences.zh: 为探究这种同质性的根源，我们考察了 Transformer 的中间特征，并观察到零频空间平均（DC）分量在生成早期就迅速跨种子（seed）收敛，导致早期轨迹锁定，从而限制了后续的多样性。

sentences.en: Building on this, we propose DC Attenuation for diVersity Enhancement (\textbf{DAVE}), a training-free representation-level intervention that selectively attenuates this component in the early regime.
sentences.zh: 基于此，我们提出了用于多样性增强的 DC 衰减（\textbf{DAVE}）——一种无需训练、作用在表示层的干预方法，在早期阶段选择性地衰减这一分量。

sentences.en: DAVE preserves the sampling pipeline with negligible overhead, improving prompt-consistent diversity while maintaining competitive image quality.
sentences.zh: DAVE 以可忽略的开销保留采样流程，在提升与提示一致性的多样性的同时，保持了有竞争力的图像质量。
